text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Seiun
Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is a little out of the blue,
but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no reason—just something to talk
about.
C'mon, close your eyes and
picture this.
choice_data_list_en: What are you talking about all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's a pond in front of you. You're
holding a
fishing rod in your hands...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well? Do you wanna fish now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! Let's go do it for real, then! I'm
itching to
reel in a big one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks in the direction of a claw
machine
packed full of Umamusume
plushies. Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This should be a cinch for an expert
angler like
you, Trainer! ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can almost feel her pulling my strings
like some
kind of puppeteer. But I'm her
trainer, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
